fusions.name: Dive and Surface
fusions.desc: Dives you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then gaffs it for 13 water damage, leaving it [Soaked] for 5 seconds and [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Idle Dabble
fusions.desc: A reach that deals 4 water damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you slip 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Slides Off, Snags Them
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.
